input.overview: Time 2000 builds two clock bonuses. Advance the A.M. or P.M. clock with its targets and triple-advance lane, then collect A.M. in the center hole or P.M. in the right hole. Knock down both drop targets to light Double Bonus; complete them again on the same ball to light a moving Extra Ball award.
input.simpleOverview: In Time 2000, advance the A.M. or P.M. clock with that side's targets and triple-advance lane. Collect A.M. in the center hole or P.M. in the right hole. Knock down both drop targets for Double Bonus, then complete them again on the same ball to light a moving Extra Ball award.
input.summary: Choose one clock rather than splitting progress. Read the lamps because many switches change the active clock. Build Double Bonus early, then collect a developed clock from its hole when the feed is safe. Time moving Extra Ball and Special awards for a reachable lane or hole.

quickInfo.name: Clock bonuses
quickInfo.summary: Advance the A.M. or P.M. clock; each clock reaches 12 independently.

quickInfo.name: Clock collects
quickInfo.summary: The center hole collects and retains A.M.; the right hole collects and retains P.M.

quickInfo.name: Drop targets
quickInfo.summary: Complete both drops once for Double Bonus and again on the same ball to light Extra Ball.

quickInfo.name: Moving awards
quickInfo.summary: Slings, bumpers and change switches rotate the lit Extra Ball and Special locations.

steps.text: Read which clock is lit, then use that side's 100-point advance targets or triple-advance lane.
Knock down both drop targets to light Double Bonus; on the last ball, the same completion can light Triple Bonus when Double Bonus begins lit.
Complete the two drops again on the same ball to light the moving Extra Ball award.
Collect a developed A.M. clock in the center hole or a developed P.M. clock in the right hole when the return is controlled.
Before shooting Extra Ball or Special, wait for its lamp to rotate to a reachable lane or hole.
Complete the two drop targets for Double Bonus.
Collect that clock in its hole, or keep it for the end-of-ball collect.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: Use small early nudges to keep the slow widebody feed near the lit clock side instead of reacting after it reaches the lower slings.

machineSetup: Confirm three- or five-ball play, automatic Double Bonus on the last ball, Extra Ball and Special conversions, and whether only one extra ball can be earned per ball.
Test both drop targets and reset, both clocks and their lamps, every advance switch, the center and right kickout holes, the right outlane gate, moving award lamps, and tilt response.

playfieldReferences.label: Left A.M. bonus clock
playfieldReferences.description: Left clock advanced by its targets and collected in the center hole.

playfieldReferences.label: Right P.M. bonus clock
playfieldReferences.description: Right clock advanced by its targets and collected in the right hole.

playfieldReferences.label: Two drop targets
playfieldReferences.description: Pair that qualifies Double Bonus and then the moving Extra Ball award.

playfieldReferences.label: Triple A.M. and P.M. advance lanes
playfieldReferences.description: Upper lanes that add three steps to the corresponding clock.
